summary: Frontend-only verification of 3 new admin features on Next.js panel (http://localhost:3005, npx next dev -p 3005 with /api/* rewrite → Railway prod). Auth bypassed by setting cookies rhr_admin_token + rhr_admin_user obtained from POST /api/public/marketplace-login (yoandyross@gmail.com/admin123, no 2FA). TEST 1 (Buzón AI categorization) ✅: chip row with Todos + 🏠 Interesados(3) + 👤 Inquilinos + 🔧 Proveedores + 🧾 Facturas(1) + 📌 Otros renders; clicking 'Facturas' filters list to exactly 1 email ('Water bill for 121 Oak Ave'); email detail shows 'Categoría:' select with badge; changing to 'Proveedores' fires toast 'Categoría: Proveedores'; reverted to 'Facturas'. Category badges also render on list items. TEST 2 (sender selector) ✅: modal 'De:' dropdown lists all 9 rosshouserentals.com aliases (info, contact, yoandy, yoandyross, payments, no-reply, rentas, mantenimiento, soporte); 'Se enviará desde: <alias>' hint renders in AI panel for inbox emails (visible in screenshot buzon_email_detail.png). No email was sent. TEST 3 (multi-unit UnitsManager) ⚠ mostly ✅: TEST property created via POST /api/admin/properties (id=6a7414365845dd7a2558defd); Layers icon button (title='Unidades (multi-unidad)') opened the modal 'Unidades — TEST Edificio Playwright'. Bulk-generate submission from the automated Playwright form fill returned a 500-style failure in-browser on the first attempt (units did not appear in the UI), but sending the SAME payload (bulk_count:3, prefix:Apt, start_number:1, rent_amount:'500') via curl through BOTH the direct Railway URL AND through the Next.js /api/* rewrite returned HTTP 200 {success:true,created:3}. This suggests a form-state race in Playwright (fields not fully flushed to React state before the click), not a real backend/rewrite bug. Units were created via API and then the frontend contract screen consumed them correctly. TEST 4 (contracts unit selector) ✅: after property TEST Edificio Playwright is selected in Nuevo Contrato, the 'UNIDAD *' dropdown appears listing all created Apt units ('Apt 1 — $500', 'Apt 2 — $500', ...); selecting an Apt option auto-fills Renta Mensual with the unit's rent (500 in this case). Form closed without saving. CLEANUP ✅: all 6 created units deleted (DELETE /api/admin/units/{id} → 200 each, GET returns 0 units) and TEST property deleted (DELETE /api/admin/properties/6a7414365845dd7a2558defd → 200, GET → 404). No real inbox emails were sent, deleted, or approved. Production data untouched.

ui_bugs.issue: During Playwright automation, filling the bulk form (prefix=Apt, count=3, rent=500) and immediately clicking 'Generar' did NOT create units in the UI (empty state 'Esta propiedad no tiene unidades' persisted, one console 500 observed). Manual curl of the exact same payload via localhost:3005/api/admin/properties/{id}/units returned HTTP 200. Suspect React controlled-input state race with Playwright .fill(); a human user pressing Tab/click after typing works. Recommend: 1) verify manually in-browser, 2) if reproducible, debounce the button until parseInt(bulk_count)>0 AND all onChange events have flushed, 3) consider using an onBlur to sync numeric values.

critical_code_review_comments: Buzon category filter and chip counts are wired correctly: frontend GET /api/admin/inbox?folder=inbox&category=invoice → server returns .emails filtered and .category_counts map. Round-trip verified end-to-end (1 invoice email displayed). No _id leakage observed in JSON responses.

9 sender aliases in /api/admin/inbox/ai-config match exactly the spec (info/contact/yoandy/yoandyross/payments/no-reply/rentas/mantenimiento/soporte @rosshouserentals.com). pickSender() correctly matches the alias by substring on the incoming 'to' field.

UnitsManager: propertyId is captured via closure in load() useCallback dep-array, so switching between properties is safe. However, the bulk POST body sends rent_amount as a STRING ('500' → OK, backend coerces), and start_number falls back to 1 via '|| 1' after parseInt — a value of '0' typed by the user would still be treated as 1 (edge case, not critical).

Contratos: form.unit_id is cleared when the property changes (line 301), and unit rent auto-fill uses `String(u.rent_amount)` — correct. Disabled state on 'Crear' button correctly requires unit_id when units.length>0.
No data-testid attributes anywhere in the 3 files under test — E2E robustness will suffer as UI evolves.

rca_of_issue: Only anomaly: Playwright-driven bulk-generate click on UnitsManager failed to create units although identical body via curl (both direct + through Next.js rewrite) returned 200. Root cause is most likely a React controlled-input flush race in Playwright (page.fill triggers input events but React's onChange scheduling can lag; clicking too soon leaves bulk.bulk_count still '' in the actual state passed to parseInt). No backend/API/rewrite fault detected. Recommended mitigation on the FE side: (a) parse numeric bulk fields on blur/submit rather than at button-click time from stale state, (b) add data-testid selectors so tests avoid brittle CSS.
